explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/371 (Erdős–Pomerance): with P(n) the largest prime factor of n, show that {n : P(n) < P(n+1)} has density 1/2. The page now records a formalised proof of this. The Lean statement: {n | maxPrimeFac (n+1) > maxPrimeFac n} has natural density 1/2. Conventions for P(0), P(1) affect at most two values of n and are irrelevant for density. Faithful.
